---
title: "Curriculum Vitae"
description: "Short and comprehensive curriculum vitae for Matthew D. Webb, Associate Professor of Economics at Carleton University."
page-layout: full
---

<div class="cv-page-intro">
  <p>The short CV is displayed below. Open either version in a separate tab for a full-screen view.</p>
  <div class="cv-actions"><a id="cv-open-short" class="button button-primary" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattdwebb/cv/main/webb_CV_short.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open short CV full screen</a><a class="button" href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattdwebb/cv/main/webb_CV.pdf" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open full CV</a></div>
</div>

<div class="cv-viewer-shell">
  <p id="cv-viewer-status" class="cv-viewer-status">Loading short CV&hellip;</p>
  <iframe id="cv-viewer" class="cv-viewer" title="Matthew D. Webb short curriculum vitae" hidden></iframe>
  <noscript>
    <p class="cv-viewer-status">JavaScript is required for the inline preview. <a href="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattdwebb/cv/main/webb_CV_short.pdf">Open the short CV directly</a>.</p>
  </noscript>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  const source = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattdwebb/cv/main/webb_CV_short.pdf";
  const viewer = document.getElementById("cv-viewer");
  const status = document.getElementById("cv-viewer-status");
  const openShort = document.getElementById("cv-open-short");

  fetch(source, { cache: "no-cache" })
    .then((response) => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("PDF request failed: " + response.status);
      return response.arrayBuffer();
    })
    .then((buffer) => {
      const pdfUrl = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([buffer], { type: "application/pdf" }));
      viewer.src = pdfUrl + "#view=FitH";
      openShort.href = pdfUrl;
      viewer.hidden = false;
      status.hidden = true;
      window.addEventListener("beforeunload", () => URL.revokeObjectURL(pdfUrl), { once: true });
    })
    .catch(() => {
      status.innerHTML = 'The preview could not be loaded. <a href="' + source + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Open the short CV directly</a>.';
    });
})();
</script>
